verbatim_locators.evidence_for: Triac enters cells independently of MCT8 (stated by the authors, not measured here)
verbatim_locators.quote: Triac is a thyroid hormone analogue whose cellular entry is not dependent on MCT8

verbatim_locators.evidence_for: No neurological efficacy claim can be drawn from Trial I
verbatim_locators.quote: The current trial was not designed to detect whether Triac also modulates neurodevelopment in human MCT8 deficiency, since it lacked specific neurodevelopmental outcomes and enrolled patients of all ages.

verbatim_locators.evidence_for: Seizure frequency rose in 3 patients with pre-existing seizures on Triac (confounded: one with a gastrointestinal infection, two with difficult-to-control seizures)
verbatim_locators.quote: In three subjects with pre-existing seizures an increase in seizure frequency was reported.

verbatim_locators.evidence_for: Treatment-related adverse events in Trial I
verbatim_locators.quote: All seven adverse events that were suspected to be related to Triac treatment, occurring in six (13%) patients, were mild and involved a transient increase in perspiration (3 patients) and irritability (3 patients).

verbatim_locators.evidence_for: Exploratory neurological signal limited to early treatment, small numbers
verbatim_locators.quote: The greatest increase in gross motor function was observed in patients in whom Triac treatment was started before the age of 4 years

verbatim_locators.evidence_for: Thyroid axis suppression by Triac with unknown brain consequence
verbatim_locators.quote: It is unknown if the further reduction in circulating T4 concentrations under Triac treatment aggravates the hypothyroid state in the brain in human MCT8 deficiency.
